p.s: Nowadays young people have many different kind to happiness and they are n't the problems that their parents had.
In my personal opinion is not true that the young people do not give enough time to helping their communities.
Further, I want to say that the young people have a responsability and the possibility to study, then they became adult leater.
Then, they are few times for helping their comunities.
I realy true that many no profit organizationes ( ONLUS ) can doing their activites because many young people work free for their.
At this days, for a young person, is very difficult chosing to going in Africa, or in another pure zone of the world, for helping the population.
But a lot of young people do it.
Also many organizations of cities, for exemple churc or CRI, have help by the young peolpe.

Another point that I think is it important to mention is that in a world full of elettronic intrateniment, money and when the possibility to travel and enjoy yourshelf are more it is very difficult filling the need to help the comunities.

In my personal own opionion for improving the number of the young people that decided to helping their comunities is more important educating and teaching to children the importance of frendly, carity and love.
